result.explanation: The conditional rule is: process each event against the current version/value; only strictly newer, causally valid updates advance state, while conflicting or causally invalid updates request one snapshot until a successful advance rearms the latch. Acknowledgements only record the current version.
result.mapping: config.version/value initialize v/x; acknowledged is a, and the request latch is l. Each event maps to one output snapshot of v, x, a, and effects.
result.assumptions: Inputs follow the stated legal numeric and JSON constraints. Unknown event types are no-ops because no other behavior is specified.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let c=input.config,s={v:c.version,x:c.value,a:-1,l:false};for(let i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){let e=input.events[i],f=[],t=e&&e.type;if(t==='delta'){if(e.base===s.v&&e.version>s.v){s.v=e.version;s.x+=e.delta;s.l=false}else if(e.version>s.v&&!s.l){s.l=true;f=[{type:'snapshot',base:s.v}]}}else if(t==='snapshot'){if(e.version>s.v){s.v=e.version;s.x=e.value;s.l=false}else if(e.version===s.v&&e.value!==s.x&&!s.l){s.l=true;f=[{type:'snapshot',base:s.v}]}}else if(t==='ack'&&e.version===s.v)s.a=s.v;let q={version:s.v,value:s.x,acknowledged:s.a,effects:f};if(JSON.stringify(q)!==JSON.stringify(output[i]))return false}return true}
